Summary

CBPAUP0C is a batch COBOL IMS program within the CardDemo Authorization Module that deletes expired pending authorization messages from the IMS database. The program reads pending authorization summary and detail segments, evaluates each detail record against a configurable expiry threshold (in days), and deletes those that have exceeded the expiry period. If all detail records under a summary are removed, the summary record itself is also deleted, and periodic checkpoints are taken to ensure recoverability.
- **Execution Environment**: Batch - **Database Access**: IMS - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main/Driver module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Initialization - Accept current date and Julian date from the system, read input parameters (expiry days, checkpoint frequency, checkpoint display frequency, debug flag) from SYSIN, and apply default values if parameters are missing or invalid 2: Parameter Validation and Defaulting - Validate expiry days parameter and default to 5 if non-numeric; default checkpoint frequency to 5 if blank or zero; default checkpoint display frequency to 10 if blank or zero; default debug flag to 'N' if not 'Y' 3: Read Next Pending Authorization Summary Record - Sequentially retrieve the next pending authorization summary record (root segment) from the authorization database, incrementing the summary read counter and tracking the current account ID 4: Read Next Pending Authorization Detail Record - Retrieve the next child detail record associated with the current authorization summary, incrementing the detail read counter; set flag to indicate no more details when end of children is reached 5: Check if Authorization Detail is Expired - Calculate the authorization date by converting the stored date value (99999 minus stored date), compute the difference in days between the current Julian date and the authorization date, and determine if the record qualifies for deletion based on whether the day difference meets or exceeds the configured expiry days threshold 6: Update Summary Counts for Expired Authorization - If the authorization detail is expired and the response code indicates approval ('00'), subtract 1 from the approved authorization count and subtract the approved amount from the approved authorization amount in the summary; otherwise subtract 1 from the declined authorization count and subtract the transaction amount from the declined authorization amount 7: Delete Expired Authorization Detail Record - Delete the expired pending authorization detail record from the database and increment the detail deleted counter 8: Delete Authorization Summary Record - After processing all detail records for a summary, check if both approved and declined authorization counts are zero or less; if so, delete the parent summary record from the database and increment the summary deleted counter 9: Checkpoint Processing - Periodically take an IMS checkpoint after processing a configured number of summary records to save progress; reset the summary processed counter after each checkpoint; display checkpoint progress information at configured display frequency intervals 10: Processing Loop Control - Iterate through all pending authorization summary records; for each summary, iterate through all associated detail records, check expiry, delete expired details, then evaluate whether the summary itself should be deleted, and take checkpoints at configured intervals 11: Final Summary Reporting - At end of processing, display total counts including: total summary records read, summary records deleted, total detail records read, and detail records deleted

Datasource Information (2)

Datasource Name Type Usage
PAUTSUM0 IMS Segment Read (GN) to retrieve each Pending Authorization Summary (root segment); Deleted (DLET) when all associated detail records have been removed
PAUTDTL1 IMS Segment Read (GNP) to retrieve Pending Authorization Detail records (child segment) under each summary; Deleted (DLET) when the detail record is determined to be expired

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Accept Current Date and Julian Date at Program Startup-L1: ```cobol ACCEPT CURRENT-DATE FROM DATE ACCEPT CURRENT-YYDDD FROM DAY DISPLAY 'STARTING PROGRAM CBPAUP0C::' DISPLAY 'TODAYS DATE :' CURRENT-YYDDD ``` Read Input Parameters from SYSIN-L1: ```cobol ACCEPT PRM-INFO FROM SYSIN DISPLAY 'CBPAUP0C PARM RECEIVED :' PRM-INFO ``` Default Expiry Days When Parameter Is Non-Numeric-L1: ```cobol IF P-EXPIRY-DAYS IS NUMERIC MOVE P-EXPIRY-DAYS TO WS-EXPIRY-DAYS ELSE MOVE 5 TO WS-EXPIRY-DAYS END-IF ``` Default Checkpoint Frequency When Parameter Is Missing or Zero-L1: ```cobol IF P-CHKP-FREQ = SPACES OR 0 OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 5 TO P-CHKP-FREQ END-IF ``` Default Checkpoint Display Frequency When Parameter Is Missing or Zero-L1: ```cobol IF P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ = SPACES OR 0 OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 10 TO P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ END-IF ``` Default Debug Flag When Not Explicitly Enabled-L1: ```cobol IF P-DEBUG-FLAG NOT = 'Y' MOVE 'N' TO P-DEBUG-FLAG END-IF ``` Read Next Pending Authorization Summary Record-L1: ```cobol EXEC DLI GN USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM) SEGMENT (PAUTSUM0) INTO (PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY) END-EXEC EVALUATE DIBSTAT WHEN ' ' SET NOT-END-OF-AUTHDB TO TRUE ADD 1 TO WS-NO-SUMRY-READ ADD 1 TO WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT MOVE PA-ACCT-ID TO WS-CURR-APP-ID ``` Detect End of Authorization Database During Summary Read-L1: ```cobol EVALUATE DIBSTAT WHEN 'GB' SET END-OF-AUTHDB TO TRUE END-EVALUATE ``` Read Next Pending Authorization Detail Record-L1: ```cobol EXEC DLI GNP USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM) SEGMENT (PAUTDTL1) INTO (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS) END-EXEC EVALUATE DIBSTAT WHEN ' ' SET MORE-AUTHS TO TRUE ADD 1 TO WS-NO-DTL-READ ``` Detect No More Detail Records Under Current Summary-L1: ```cobol EVALUATE DIBSTAT WHEN 'GE' WHEN 'GB' SET NO-MORE-AUTHS TO TRUE END-EVALUATE ``` Convert Stored Authorization Date to Comparable Julian Date-L1: ```cobol COMPUTE WS-AUTH-DATE = 99999 - PA-AUTH-DATE-9C ``` Calculate Age of Authorization in Days-L1: ```cobol COMPUTE WS-DAY-DIFF = CURRENT-YYDDD - WS-AUTH-DATE ``` Determine if Authorization Detail Qualifies for Deletion-L1: ```cobol IF WS-DAY-DIFF >= WS-EXPIRY-DAYS SET QUALIFIED-FOR-DELETE TO TRUE ELSE SET NOT-QUALIFIED-FOR-DELETE TO TRUE END-IF ``` Update Summary Approved Count and Amount for Expired Approved Authorization-L1: ```cobol IF PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE = '00' SUBTRACT 1 FROM PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT SUBTRACT PA-APPROVED-AMT FROM PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT ``` Update Summary Declined Count and Amount for Expired Declined Authorization-L1: ```cobol ELSE SUBTRACT 1 FROM PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT SUBTRACT PA-TRANSACTION-AMT FROM PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT END-IF ``` Delete Expired Authorization Detail Record-L1: ```cobol EXEC DLI DLET USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM) SEGMENT (PAUTDTL1) FROM (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS) END-EXEC IF DIBSTAT = SPACES ADD 1 TO WS-NO-DTL-DELETED ``` Evaluate Whether Authorization Summary Record Should Be Deleted-L1: ```cobol IF PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT <= 0 AND PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT <= 0 PERFORM 6000-DELETE-AUTH-SUMMARY THRU 6000-EXIT END-IF ``` Delete Authorization Summary Record When No Remaining Authorizations-L1: ```cobol EXEC DLI DLET USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM) SEGMENT (PAUTSUM0) FROM (PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY) END-EXEC IF DIBSTAT = SPACES ADD 1 TO WS-NO-SUMRY-DELETED ``` Trigger Checkpoint Based on Summary Records Processed Count-L1: ```cobol IF WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT > P-CHKP-FREQ PERFORM 9000-TAKE-CHECKPOINT THRU 9000-EXIT MOVE 0 TO WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT END-IF ``` Take IMS Checkpoint and Display Progress at Configured Intervals-L1: ```cobol EXEC DLI CHKP ID(WK-CHKPT-ID) END-EXEC IF DIBSTAT = SPACES ADD 1 TO WS-NO-CHKP IF WS-NO-CHKP >= P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ MOVE 0 TO WS-NO-CHKP DISPLAY 'CHKP SUCCESS: AUTH COUNT - ' WS-NO-SUMRY-READ ', APP ID - ' WS-CURR-APP-ID END-IF ``` Iterate Through All Summary and Detail Records-L1: ```cobol PERFORM UNTIL ERR-FLG-ON OR END-OF-AUTHDB PERFORM 3000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-DTL THRU 3000-EXIT PERFORM UNTIL NO-MORE-AUTHS PERFORM 4000-CHECK-IF-EXPIRED THRU 4000-EXIT IF QUALIFIED-FOR-DELETE PERFORM 5000-DELETE-AUTH-DTL THRU 5000-EXIT END-IF PERFORM 3000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-DTL THRU 3000-EXIT END-PERFORM ``` Take Final Checkpoint After All Records Are Processed-L1: ```cobol PERFORM 9000-TAKE-CHECKPOINT THRU 9000-EXIT ``` Display Final Processing Summary Report-L1: ```cobol DISPLAY '*-------------------------------------*' DISPLAY '# TOTAL SUMMARY READ :' WS-NO-SUMRY-READ DISPLAY '# SUMMARY REC DELETED :' WS-NO-SUMRY-DELETED DISPLAY '# TOTAL DETAILS READ :' WS-NO-DTL-READ DISPLAY '# DETAILS REC DELETED :' WS-NO-DTL-DELETED DISPLAY '*-------------------------------------*' ```
